review: Independent unique byte-window matches against checksum-verified stock 2168446 and new native disassembly locate every module-ID site, both initialization branches and loader registration. Registers, branch destinations, callback and the 0xed0 vehicle field retain their contracts. Primary native FName decoder at 0xf9c0ce4 confirms pool/ready globals, block offset 0x68, two-byte indexing and string header layout. SEED_ofb128_encrypt ends with ret before all 231 executable padding bytes. All patch locations retain their 2180427 addresses and guarded bytes, despite a changed executable checksum. Detours are regenerated with the unchanged Tank-only generator; ordinary vehicle IDs remain native.
